story_type: tug and barge rolls over offshore, four in a life raft in whitecaps, boat crew pickup and helicopter hoist
hook: Their tug rolled over. Four people ended up in this raft.
narration: Their tug and barge rolled onto its side with four people aboard.
One of the crew got a Mayday call out at four forty-seven in the afternoon.
All four ended up in a life raft off Freeport, Texas, with whitecaps breaking around them.
A Coast Guard helicopter from Houston found the raft and called in a forty-five foot response boat.
A raft rides low and disappears in the swells, so the helicopter stays overhead and talks the boat crew straight onto it.
The boat crew came alongside and pulled three of them aboard.
[short pause] The fourth had a back injury, so the helicopter lowered its hoist.
outcome: The boat crew took three to Station Freeport, and the helicopter flew the fourth to a hospital in Galveston.
title: Tug rolled over, 4 in a life raft
description:
On May 13, 2024, Coast Guard boat and helicopter crews rescued four people from a life raft after their tug and barge rolled over near Freeport, Texas.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video, courtesy Air Station Corpus Christi, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/923415/coast-guard-rescues-4-boaters-near-freeport-texas
